extracted.name: Slow Cooker Cornish Hens
extracted.description: In this recipe, Cornish game hens are coated, stuffed with a mushroom soup-veggie mixture, and simmered in a slow cooker for a make-ahead meal for two.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can golden mushroom soup (such as Campbell's®), divided
1 (7 ounce) jar pimento-stuffed green olives, drained and chopped
instruction_lines: Coat hens with about 1/4 mushroom soup.

Combine remaining 3/4 mushroom soup, portobello mushrooms, zucchini, olives, and garlic salt in a bowl; stuff mixture inside hens. Arrange hens, breast-sides up, in a slow cooker. Spoon any remaining soup mixture over hens.
Cover slow cooker. Cook on High for 4 hours.
